evidence_slice: Ordnance Survey's official OS OpenMap–Local documentation describes an open, detailed street-level mapping product for Great Britain, states that it contains important buildings and functional sites, and offers Exeter as one of the online sample-data areas. The same public no-login documentation window does not expose a record-level Exeter building feature with polygon coordinates and explicit building classification/type/use bound to that same feature. No geometry or type/use value was inferred or fabricated; the inspected material is source-area/product metadata only and receives no parcel-progress credit.

field_evidence.footprint: Official OS OpenMap–Local documentation describes detailed/generalised street-level mapping and important buildings, but the selected documentation window exposes no record-level Exeter building polygon coordinates.
field_evidence.type_use: The selected public documentation describes important buildings and functional sites at product level only; no explicit building classification/type/use is bound to an individual Exeter building feature in this window.
field_evidence.source_area: Official Ordnance Survey product documentation identifies Exeter sample data and product coverage. Source-area/product metadata only; no parcel-progress credit.
